# Round up

## 1. Open the app
Open {{app_url}} and wait for the page to finish loading.

## 2. Type "120" in "Bill", "15" in "Tip %" and "4" in "People"
Type "120" in "Bill", "15" in "Tip %" and "4" in "People".

## 3. Tick "Round up to whole dollars"
Tick "Round up to whole dollars".

## 4. You should see "Each person pays $35.00" and "Collected…
